title: Is fast mode right here?
intro: Pick your situation and see whether fast mode helps.

inputs.label: Situation
options: Live debugging with Opus on the Anthropic API

when.equals: Live debugging with Opus on the Anthropic API

show.title: Turn it on
show.detail: Fast mode gives the same model quality with much quicker replies, which suits rapid back-and-forth. It costs more per token.

show.title: Not supported
show.detail: Fast mode is offered for certain Opus and Fable models, not Sonnet or Haiku.

trace.text: Fast mode isn't available for this model.

show.title: Not available
show.detail: Fast mode isn't offered on Bedrock or Microsoft Foundry.

trace.text: Fast mode isn't available on this provider.

show.title: Use lower effort instead
show.detail: Fast mode trades a higher price for speed. To save cost, lower the effort level or pick a smaller model.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: What changes when fast mode is on?
options: Replies come faster at a higher price, same model
quiz.explanation: It's the same model served with a speed-focused setup, billed at a higher rate.
